label: Currency Rupee
depicts: Standalone rupee currency sign with one top bar and one diagonal tail
use_when: Use when the interface wants the rupee sign alone with a top bar and diagonal tail.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring rupee sign when the symbol should stay inside a circular border.

label: Currency Shekel
depicts: Shekel currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the shekel symbol enclosed inside a circular ring frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone shekel symbol when the outer ring should not remain visible.

label: Currency Shekel
depicts: Standalone shekel currency sign with one mirrored loop shape and one right stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants the shekel symbol by itself with its mirrored loop form visible.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring shekel sign when the symbol should stay inside a circle.

label: Currency Won
depicts: Won currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the won symbol enclosed inside a thin circular ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone won sign when the outer ring should be absent.

label: Currency Won
depicts: Standalone won currency sign with one w shape and two crossbars across the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants the won sign alone with two short crossbars through the w shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring won sign when the symbol should remain enclosed.
